source.supplied_project_gdd: Breath of Fire IV Fishing Minigame - Comprehensive Game Design Document
source.note: The original supplied GDD listed 27 fish and contained several fish-stat discrepancies. v2 uses the verified 30-fish table for fish size/king/max-points/lure/spot facts, with English FAQs used for item effects/worth. Authored gameplay tuning remains explicitly separate.

fish.name: Blue Gill
fish.effect: Casts a minor Water attack on one enemy.

fish.name: Bullcat
fish.effect: Casts a minor Fire/Earth attack on all enemies.

fish.name: Barandy
fish.effect: Restores one ally to full HP.

fish.name: Sturgeon
fish.effect: Revives all KO'd allies to 25% HP.

fish.name: Moorfish
fish.effect: Revives one KO'd ally with 1 HP; may fail.

fish.name: Flatfish
fish.effect: Cures all status ailments on one ally.

fish.name: Bonito
fish.effect: Restores one ally to full HP.

fish.name: Angler
fish.effect: Casts a major Wind/Water attack on all enemies.

fish.name: Whale
fish.effect: Restores full HP and cures status for all allies.

lures.name: Tail

lures.acquisition: Trade: Lyp (Browntail x1, Trout x1, Sweetfish x1).

lures.name: Warbler

spots.name: River 1
spots.depth_notes: Shallow; waterfall area is useful for Rainbow Trout.

spots.name: Lake 1
spots.depth_notes: Lake population; Martian Squid is present.

spots.name: Lake 2
spots.depth_notes: Lake population including Black Bass and Dorado.

spots.name: Ocean 2
spots.depth_notes: Deep ocean population including Spearfish and Whale.

spots.name: Saldine
spots.depth_notes: Saldine-only population includes Moorfish and Black Porgy.

implementation_notes.portraits: All 30 FishData resources contain AtlasTexture portrait regions referencing res://assets/sprites/Atlas_Fishes.png.
implementation_notes.authored_values: Normalized depth ranges, stamina, strength, resistance rounds, recovery timing and movement personalities are gameplay-authored values and are not presented as canonical BOF4 numeric mechanics.
implementation_notes.unchanged_from_v1: 19 lure resources, 6 rod resources and the 8 GDD-documented example trade resources are carried forward.
